channel.title: Hacker News Top 10
channel.description: Daily top 10 stories from the Hacker News front page, curated by Update Bot.

item.title: Hacker News top 10 — Tue, Nov 10
item.description:
The top 10 stories on the Hacker News front page on Tuesday, Nov 10, 2026, in front-page order.

  1. Amazon saves millions by replacing Sonnet 4.6 with Strands Decider · strandsagents.com

    Two Amazon engineers replaced Claude Sonnet 4.6 with a decision model, Strands Decider, in a large internal ticketing system, and the post says the change is saving millions.

    170 points · 50 comments

  2. Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 · anthropic.com

    Anthropic's new models for hard technical work. Anthropic says they are up to 30% faster than the 5.1 versions and cost $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens.

    516 points · 760 comments

  3. USPS now offers official ZIP Code boundary polygons · postalpro.usps.com

    The Postal Service is publishing official national ZIP Code boundary polygons, drawn from delivery addresses, for mapping, mailing and marketing use.

    605 points · 302 comments

  4. Your TV can see through walls · maurycyz.com

    A project showing that a TV station's radio signal can be disturbed enough to detect someone walking, including in a neighboring room.

    69 points · 17 comments

  5. Locating the source of a mysterious beep · simonwillison.net

    Simon Willison used Claude to help build a Beep Locator app that turns several nearby devices into microphones to find an intermittent beep in a storage room.

    149 points · 69 comments

  6. E-means: Outperforming k-means in one-tenth the epochs · e-means.github.io

    A Meta FAIR clustering algorithm, now in Faiss, that the authors say beats standard k-means in about one-tenth the epochs.

    379 points · 35 comments

  7. Payments Canada announces launch of Canada's Real-Time Rail (RTR) payment system · payments.ca

    Payments Canada launched the Real-Time Rail, so participating banks and payment providers can clear and settle payments around the clock.

    522 points · 283 comments

  8. Foldable Flight: The Best Paper Airplanes · foldableflight.com

    A site of paper airplane designs with video folding tutorials, which it calls the world's largest such collection.

    985 points · 148 comments

  9. Horible public key tricks · maurycyz.com

    A technical post about unusual SSL/TLS certificate tricks, including hiding a message in an RSA public key modulus.

    144 points · 44 comments

  10. Ultorg: The User Interface for Relational Databases · ultorg.com

    A spreadsheet-like interface for relational databases that lets you query and edit data across tables without writing SQL.

    45 points · 9 comments
